channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Nov 23
item.description:
189 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Fishing villages now spawn at appropriate distances from river mouths thanks to terrain filters.
  • Mission items stored in backpacks now count toward mission objectives, and dispensers track progress correctly.
  • Sleeping bags can be placed adjacent to each other; respawn space checks removed, preventing bags from getting stuck on respawn.

Movement

  • Added a modern sprint system with in‑game configurable settings, allowing players to toggle sprint without admin privileges.

NPC & AI

  • Scientists now use a replay‑based aim system, giving them accuracy comparable to real players.
  • Fixed scientists hovering when crouched, corrected aim after crouch‑hovering, and enabled proper door searching when they have a target.
  • Fixed scientists rotating incorrectly and applied seat aim limits for mounted scientists.

World & Server

  • RakNet connection slots now scale with server.maxplayers, supporting larger servers.
  • Sprinklers no longer wet players through floors or ceilings.
  • Cave blending now respects underground tunnel bunker entrances, preventing overlap with monument topology.
  • Fishing villages now spawn at appropriate distances from river mouths thanks to terrain filters.

Gameplay Interactions

  • Livestock can be renamed instantly, removing the previous delay.
  • Car repel force works correctly even when the car is positioned directly on an animal.
  • Deployables placed near a split‑off base part now correctly attach to the new building.
  • Dropping items on thin surfaces (e.g., oil rig floors) no longer fails due to line‑of‑sight checks hitting the underside.

Missions & Progress

  • Mission items stored in backpacks now count toward mission objectives, and dispensers track progress correctly.

Respawn & Sleeping Bags

  • Sleeping bags can be placed adjacent to each other; respawn space checks removed, preventing bags from getting stuck on respawn.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Items now drop correctly instead of being blocked, restoring expected loot retrieval.
  • Mounted gun and mortar hands now track pitch accurately, eliminating lag and improving aiming control.
  • Sprinkler systems correctly wet floors again, re‑enabling slip mechanics on wet surfaces.

New Content

  • Livestock animals added, providing new farming resources.

Vehicles

  • M939 Truck now spawns at Mining Quarry monuments, offering additional transport options.
  • M939 Truck also available at Gas Station monuments.

AI (WIP)

  • Experimenting with replaying human sequences for scientist movement and aiming (WIP).

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Nov 22
item.description:
121 development commits

Map Layout

  • Monuments are arranged in eccentric rings with the endgame core offset to one side; the Power Plant sits centrally, core monuments lean inward and are anchored to specific rings.
  • The first closing balloon is placed in the outer ring, away from hatches.

AI & Reinforcements

  • Tier‑2 monuments now host gunner drones that fire pistol rounds with recoil.
  • Core monuments are guarded by AI; when their guards are depleted helicopters can deliver reinforcements and a Bradley patrols the core area, and players receive warnings near monuments and before a balloon closes.

Economy & Pricing

  • Backpack sale price is fixed at 400 after completing Missing Shipment, and loot items have fixed rarity‑based pricing that no longer varies with colour.
  • Item values are calculated from supply stock and a fixed shop list (bandit camp excluded); gold‑floor items, condition‑scaled sales and blueprint prices are defined without bandit influence, the safe pocket only accepts non‑weapon/armour items and values them as the shop would pay, and the shop now buys only finished goods while components are sent to a recycler for a refund.

Inventory & Loot

  • Stash capacity increased by two rows at a time up to a maximum of 96 slots.
  • Low‑tier crates and barrels now contain fewer tools and weapons, and junk‑pile crates no longer include ring parts.

Raid & Extraction

  • Extraction balloons no longer carry a secondary hot‑air balloon; escape hatches can be opened with a Cobalt bypass card; outer‑ring crates now have a rare jackpot chance; and raid duration is extended to 35 minutes.
  • Raid reset now removes player‑placed structures along with their contents.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Improved beach spawn locations reduce clustering and give more reliable initial placement.
  • Fishing vendor updates add new bait options and adjust pricing for better resource management.
  • Fixed overlapping train tunnel geometry, preventing players from getting stuck or falling through tunnels.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Nov 21
item.description:
68 development commits

NPC & AI

  • Fixed lambs getting stuck and failing to follow a sprinting player when led.
  • Scout NPCs that become trapped against signs or poles now automatically free themselves.

Monuments & World

  • Monument guard NPCs now spread out, scale with monument size, and can stand on any floor.
  • Raid maps now spawn only whitelisted monuments, with each tier‑1 monument appearing once per map.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Stash UI no longer repeats the bank balance, showing the correct amount only.
  • Bank balance is now always displayed on the Outpost screen for continuous fund monitoring.
